reviewed_by: Automated static review (Binary Ninja + Radare2 CFG, signature, behaviour note)

runtime_contract.note: The live differential compares the calls that naturally happened, with the argument words and the result of each call. A pointer value from one process is not the data of the other, so a non-scalar argument is compared as the word it was, and the report says which scope it used.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: radare2 pi at 0x004A50F5 shows the retail entry (SEH frame scope table 0x534308, handler 0x4a67ec); the candidate implements that entry. The name Camera_ApplyHandiCam_3 is a catalog label only.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: The version word packing (GetVersion shifts and masks into 0x93607c, 0x936078, 0x936074, 0x936070), the 0x1c exit code and the show-window default of 10 are the literals in the retail instructions.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: The retail entry takes no arguments; main receives the module handle, a null previous instance, the command line from 0x4A5FD7 and the show-window value.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: Call order matches retail: GetVersion, 0x4A6787 then 0x4A5210(0x1c) on zero, 0x4A6467, GetCommandLineA into 0xC32554, 0x4A6335 into 0x93604C, 0x4A60E8, 0x4A602F, 0x4A5AA8, GetStartupInfoA, 0x4A5FD7, main, 0x4A5AD5.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: The candidate reads the retail data as it is stored; it performs no float arithmetic.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: The five version and command line globals are written at the retail addresses with the retail widths.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: Returns the exit code of main. Known divergence: retail SEH handler calls the exception filter 0x4A5D72 before 0x4A5A05; a C++ catch cannot recover the exception pointers so 0x4A5A05 is called with code 0.
